hull_geometry: Sharply tapered triangular hull with a needle-like prow; tiered superstructure that rises toward the aft section; recessed engine banks in the rear
materials_and_finish: Highly detailed, interlocking composite plates with minimal greebling, suggesting advanced stealth or aerodynamic properties
design_philosophy: Prioritizes speed and overwhelming forward firepower; the silhouette is reminiscent of a massive arrowhead
color_scheme: Deep obsidian and gunmetal grey metallic plating; internal recesses and weapon ports glow with a cold cyan light; gold accents along the primary axis
distinctive_traits: The tiered layering of the hull creates a sense of immense scale and complexity
